What if I told you that Invincible is actually not that invincible? And who in this massive cast of powerful characters ACTUALLY deserves that title the most? We’ve done a few theories talking about the biology and science of some of the characters in Invincible, and today I want to do something a little different and fun! In today’s episode, let’s find out who in Invincible is ACTUALLY Invincible…
